note: Hand-curated. The chants of Good Friday, which NOH does not set: the organ is silent from the Gloria of Holy Thursday to the Easter Vigil, and NOH1 goes from Maundy Thursday (p. 344) to Holy Saturday (p. 345). Each chant is named by its GregoBase id, checked against the edition and page GregoBase records for it (never chosen by incipit similarity). `noh chants` copies their notation into data/chants.json; tests/test_good_friday.py checks every id is there and not flagged copyrighted.
